notes_for_editor: Two guides agree on the 1932 build and 1962 destruction, and a 1962 Sandpoint News Bulletin story reprinted by Forest Lookouts describes the demolition of six lookouts, Katka Peak among them. The 1962 story says the six were built in the 1930s by the CCC; that matches 1932 but does not name Katka Peak's year. Record gave no design or height; design added from the guides, height not added because '10-foot pole' is ambiguous (the sources do not say whether it is the total height). Staffing names are the only ones listed in the sources. No photo found; no source describes the site today.
